terms.gloss: a roller: a stone roller for levelling ground; used here for a paint roller
evidence: Verg. G. 1.178: ārea cum prīmīs ingentī aequanda cylindrō
terms.comment: Classically a cylinder, and the stone roller that levelled a threshing floor; its use for a paint roller is modern, and ours. No reference work has a word for a paint roller. The y is short (Lewis & Short cylindrus).

phrases.english: We put the paint on the wall with the roller.

phrases.latin: ārea cum prīmīs ingentī aequanda cylindrō
phrases.english: first of all the threshing floor must be levelled with a huge roller
